name: Toki Yuzuru
source:
He is friends with Rin since childhood.
Wanting to spend as much time as possible with his first love, Rin, he hides the fact that he is a childhood friend and applies to do odd jobs at Rin's production company.
He is in awe of Rin's efforts every day in preparation for her debut.
His hobby is computers, and he has recently been teaching himself video editing. He hopes to get a job in video production in the future.
He is unaware that Rin is living alone with Toya.
